description: This file contains an extension on the OnboardingView class, providing methods to manage workspace configurations including loading, ensuring, refreshing, applying, and saving workspace settings.

methods.name: loadWorkspaceDefaults
methods.description: Loads default workspace settings if none are configured and updates the workspace path.

methods.name: ensureDefaultWorkspace
methods.description: Ensures a default workspace is bootstrapped when in local connection mode, attempting to bootstrap if necessary.

methods.name: refreshBootstrapStatus
methods.description: Updates the status indicating whether the workspace needs to be bootstrapped.

methods.name: get workspaceBootstrapCommand
methods.description: Returns a shell script string to create and initialize the workspace directory with a template.

methods.name: applyWorkspace
methods.description: Asynchronously applies the current workspace configuration, attempting to bootstrap it if safe.

methods.name: loadAgentWorkspace
methods.description: Asynchronously loads the current workspace configuration from persistent storage.

methods.name: saveAgentWorkspace
methods.description: Saves the provided workspace string to persistent storage asynchronously.

methods.name: buildAndSaveWorkspace
methods.description: Builds a workspace configuration, saving it asynchronously, and returns success status with error message if any.
